fixed.summary: Once any document declares a property that carries computed values to its children (`list-style-type`, a wide keyword such as `inherit`, a bound declaration), a widget inside a document element (a `<kbd>` keycap in a primary `<button>`) no longer takes the colour the element only inherits (a frame's `--ink`) over its own ink. A widget's ink is over what its host inherits, as it is without carrying; what the host declares still reaches its parts.
